_note: Offline proof set for the MODELED Tenant-Scan crew (theragen_tenant_scan -> reporting). Confidential, read-only. ROBOPORT never calls Microsoft Graph; every eval runs against a synthetic site-inventory fixture (metadata only, no site content). Covers the four Phase-5 proof kinds with blockers.

evals.prompt: Run the Tenant-Scan crew on a SYNTHETIC inventory of Microsoft 365 sites (metadata only). tenant_scan produces a SiteInventory, then reporting produces a legacy-site disposition report grounded in it.
evals.expected_output: A SiteInventory whose total_sites equals the number of site entries, each with a disposition; a disposition report grounded in the inventory.
expectations: SiteInventory.total_sites equals the length of SiteInventory.sites
Every site has a site_id and title; dispositions are drawn from {keep, archive, review, dormant}
Only site metadata is present — no site file contents are read or reported
The disposition report's counts (e.g. dormant sites) match the SiteInventory
Every claim in the report traces to a site entry in the SiteInventory
blockers: SiteInventory.total_sites equals the length of SiteInventory.sites
Only site metadata is present — no site file contents are read or reported
The disposition report's counts (e.g. dormant sites) match the SiteInventory

evals.prompt: Run the crew on a tenant with zero sites returned.
evals.expected_output: The crew halts cleanly; reporting does not fabricate a disposition report over an empty inventory.
expectations: No disposition report asserting sites to archive/keep is produced
The run surfaces an 'empty inventory' message
reporting invents no sites or dispositions
blockers: No disposition report asserting sites to archive/keep is produced

evals.prompt: Same as eval 1, but tenant_scan's first response is schema-invalid (a site entry is missing site_id). Exercises the Layer-1 schema-repair path before reporting runs.
evals.expected_output: The SiteInventory recovers via at most one repair pass or the step fails cleanly; no malformed inventory reaches reporting.
expectations: tenant_scan output validates against the SiteInventory contract before reporting runs
If the one repair pass does not fix it, the step status is 'failed' with a schema-layer error
reporting never consumes a SiteInventory with a site missing its site_id
At most one schema-repair pass is attempted
blockers: reporting never consumes a SiteInventory with a site missing its site_id

evals.prompt: Run the crew on exactly 17 synthetic sites, 5 marked dormant. Verify the disposition report's figures are grounded in the inventory and never invented.
evals.expected_output: Every count in the report traces to the SiteInventory; the report states no disposition the inventory does not support.
expectations: The report's dormant-site count equals the number of sites with disposition 'dormant' (5)
No count in the report exceeds or contradicts the SiteInventory
The report recommends no action on a site absent from the inventory
blockers: The report's dormant-site count equals the number of sites with disposition 'dormant' (5)
No count in the report exceeds or contradicts the SiteInventory
